item.title: Firefighters free car passenger trapped in downtown crash
item.description: Ottawa Fire Services specialists rescued a person trapped in a badly mangled car following a two-car crash at Albert and Bay streets on Friday morning. Police alerted the fire service experts at about 9:20 a.m. One vehicle had two occupants, with the passenger trapped. The driver was alone in the second vehicle. Firefighters first stabilized […]

item.title: How I discovered a new community while learning to speedskate in Ottawa
item.description: It may be a sport, but for many Ottawa families it's much more than that.

item.title: Early intervention key to transforming lives of youth with eating disorders, CHEO researcher says
item.description: Dr. Nicole Obeid says Canada needs to do a better job of treating and supporting the 1.4 million youth with eating disorders.

item.title: Team Canada grades: Celebrini oozing confidence, Crosby makes history in blowout win over France
item.description: Macklin Celebrini took the tournament lead in goals, Connor McDavid had another three points, and Sidney Crosby passed Jarome Iginla to become Canada's all-time leader in points at the Winter Olympics during the NHL era.

item.title: Political street theatre brings attention, laughs on Rideau Canal
item.description: Velvet LeClair's papier mâché likeness of U.S. President Donald Trump drew a lot of attention from skaters on the Rideau Canal on Sunday.

item.title: Longtime Ottawa radio personality Lowell Green dead at 89
item.description: Green was best known for his role at CFRA, for many years.
